info.title: Stepclimb API
info.description: The public API every Stepclimb client uses. There are no private endpoints.

get.summary:
List an account's children, or without `parent_id` the topmost accounts the caller can see:
the root for a holder of `account.view` at organization scope, otherwise each account where
the caller holds it below no other such account. Sorted by name, then id.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description:
List this account's children. Omitted, list the topmost accounts you can see with
`account.view`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page; omit it for the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items to return, 1 to 200; 50 when omitted.

delete.summary: Delete an account that has no child accounts, and the role assignments scoped to it.

patch.summary: Rename an account. A patch without `name` changes nothing.

post.summary: Move an account and its subtree under `parent_id`.

200.description: The organization's branding after the change

get.summary: List the role assignments at scopes where the caller holds `role.view`, by id.

parameters.name: scope_type
parameters.description: Only assignments at this exact scope; needs `scope_id`.

parameters.name: scope_id
parameters.description: The scope's id (the organization's own id for `organization`); needs `scope_type`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page; omit it for the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items to return, 1 to 200; 50 when omitted.

post.summary: Grant a role to a user at a scope.

get.summary: List the roles: the built-in roles, then the organization's custom roles, each by key.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page; omit it for the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items to return, 1 to 200; 50 when omitted.

delete.summary: Delete a custom role that has no assignments.

patch.summary: Change a custom role's name or permissions; holders see the change on their next request.

200.description: The signed-in user and their organization

get.summary: List the signed-in user's identities, oldest first, without the attributes providers sent.

delete.summary: Remove one of the signed-in user's identities. You must keep a way to sign in.

patch.summary: Rename the caller's organization. A patch without `name` changes nothing.

get.summary:
Read the organization's plan, every catalog feature with whether the plan includes it, and
every catalog limit with its value.

200.description: The plan and what it allows

get.summary: Read the organization settings, every key with its effective value.

200.description: Every setting with its effective value

patch.summary:
Change the settings the patch names; the others keep their value. A patch naming no setting
writes nothing.

get.summary: List the organization's users, sorted by display name, then id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A prefix of the display name or the email, in any letter case.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page; omit it for the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items to return, 1 to 200; 50 when omitted.

post.summary: Create a user, `local` and `active`, and link the identities given to them.

patch.summary:
Change a user's names, email, locale, time zone or status. A patch naming nothing changes
nothing.

get.summary: List a user's identities, oldest first.

post.summary: Link an identity to a user, so they can sign in with it.

delete.summary: Remove an identity from a user. The user must keep a way to sign in.

post.summary: End the browser's session and clear its cookie.
post.description:
Answers 204 whether or not the cookie named a session. It needs no permission and no valid
session, so a browser holding an expired or unknown cookie can still clear it.

204.description: The session, if there was one, is ended and the cookie cleared

get.summary: The server can take traffic: the database answered within two seconds.

503.description: The database did not answer in time

get.summary: The stylesheet of the request's organization: its saved branding's, or the default brand's.

200.description: The organization's light, dark and high-contrast themes as CSS variables, revalidated on every load (`Cache-Control: no-cache`)

Account.description: An account of the caller's organization.

depth.description: 0 for the root, 1 for its children, and so on; at most 16.

parent_id.description: `null` for the root only. Shown even when the parent is not visible to the caller.

AccountMove.description: The new parent of a moved account.

parent_id.description:
The new parent; you must hold `account.manage` at a scope containing it. The account's
current parent changes nothing.

AccountPatch.description:
A change to an account; an omitted member is left as it is. A member sent as `null` is
malformed: omit it instead.

AssignmentSource.description:
Who owns an assignment: an admin of this organization (`local`), or the identity provider,
sync API, SCIM or connector that wrote it, in which case it cannot be removed here.

Branding.description:
The organization's branding: the saved inputs (the default brand's when it has saved none),
the generator version, the hash of the stylesheet `/theme.css` serves, and the contrast
report of its light, dark and high-contrast themes.

css_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the stylesheet, lowercase hex.

generator.description: The version of the theme generator that wrote the stylesheet.

BrandingInputs.description:
The branding inputs. The whole set is replaced; an omitted or `null` choice takes its
default. A value that is not a choice is a 422, not a 400.

primary.description: The primary color: a CSS hex color (`#500E0E`, `#f00`) or `oklch(L C H)`, opaque.

report.description: On `branding.contrast_failed`, every appearance's report, failing pairs first.

BrandingProblem.description:
A problem details body with the contrast report: `branding.contrast_failed` carries
`report`, every other code leaves it out.

minimum.description: 4.5 for text and 3 for other pairs; 7 and 4.5 in high contrast.

ratio.description: The WCAG 2 contrast ratio on the displayed 8-bit sRGB colors, 1 to 21, unrounded.

ContrastWarning.description:
Something to look at that does not fail the theme. `brand-near-danger`: the brand's hue is
within 30 degrees of `danger`'s.

CornerStyle.description: The corner style: `square` sets the `xs`, `sm` and `md` radii to 0, `round` doubles them.

Entitlements.description: The organization's plan and what it allows: every feature and limit of the server's catalogs.

features.description: Every catalog feature, by key, with whether the plan includes it.

limits.description: Every catalog limit, by key, with the most units the plan allows, or `null` for no limit.

FieldError.description: One rule a request body broke, in a 422's `errors`.

code.description: The stable code of the rule, such as `settings.unknown_key`.

field.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the member that broke the rule, such as `/name`.

GrantScope.description:
A scope a grant or a role assignment applies at: the organization, an account or a course,
by id. An organization scope's `id` is the organization's id.

HealthStatus.description: `ok` when the probe passed, `unavailable` when it did not.

Identity.description: A user's identity as an admin sees it.

attributes.description:
The attributes the provider sent at the latest sign-in, as mapped by the provider's
configuration; `{}` before the first sign-in. Admission rules read them.

provider_key.description: The key of the identity provider.

subject.description: The provider's id for the person, exactly as the provider sends it.

features.description: The keys of the catalog features the organization's plan includes, sorted.

grants.description:
Each scope where the caller holds at least one effective permission, with those
permissions sorted: the organization first, then accounts by id. A permission held at a
scope also takes effect in every account inside it, which are not listed again.

MeGrant.description: The permissions the caller holds at one scope.

family_name.description: `""` when the identity provider sent none.

given_name.description: `""` when the identity provider sent none.

MyIdentity.description: One of the signed-in user's identities.

provider_key.description: The key of the identity provider.

provider_label.description:
The provider's label, such as "Sign in with Example"; `null` when the provider's
configuration has none.

subject.description: The provider's id for you, exactly as the provider sends it.

parent_id.description: The parent account; you must hold `account.manage` at a scope containing it.

NewIdentity.description: An identity to link to a user, so they can sign in with it the first time.

provider_key.description: The key of one of the organization's identity providers.

subject.description: The provider's id for the person; stored exactly as given, not empty.

key.description:
A lowercase letter, then up to 62 lowercase letters, digits or underscores; not the key
of a built-in role or another custom role of the organization.

permissions.description:
Catalog keys (`GET /api/v1/admin/permissions`), each at most once and each held by the
caller at organization scope.

role_id.description:
A built-in role other than `manager` and `observer`, or a custom role of the
organization.

scope.description: The organization (its own id) or an account of it. `course` is not available yet.

NewUser.description: A user to create. The new user is `local` and `active`, and has no local credential.

email.description: Trimmed; at most 254 characters; unique in the organization in any letter case.

external_id.description: At most 200 characters; unique in the organization.

identities.description:
Identities to link to the new user, so they can sign in with them the first time; at
most 20.

locale.description: `en`, the default and the only locale in M0.

tz.description: An IANA time zone; the organization's `default_tz` when omitted.

NewUserIdentity.description: An identity to link to a new user: the provider's subject at the provider with this key.

subject.description: Stored exactly as given; not empty.

OrgSettings.description:
Every organization setting with its effective value: the stored one, or the setting's
default when none is stored.

default_tz.description: The IANA time zone a user created without one gets; `UTC` unless set.

email_matching.description:
Whether a sign-in through an identity the organization does not know yet may be linked
to the existing user with the same email address. `false` unless set, and this release
refuses to set it to `true`.

OrgSettingsPatch.description:
A partial change to the organization settings: one optional member per setting; only the
members present change. A member that is no setting is refused.

default_tz.description: An IANA time zone, matched in any letter case and stored in the database's spelling.

slug.description: Fixed when the organization is created.

OrganizationPatch.description:
A change to the organization; an omitted member is left as it is. A member sent as `null`
is malformed: omit it instead.

items.description: An account of the caller's organization.

depth.description: 0 for the root, 1 for its children, and so on; at most 16.

parent_id.description: `null` for the root only. Shown even when the parent is not visible to the caller.

items.description: The items, in the list's sort order.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

items.description: A built-in role or a custom role of the organization.

builtin.description: Built-in roles are the same in every organization and cannot be changed or deleted.

permissions.description: The permission keys the role grants. A built-in role's are this server's list for it.

items.description: The items, in the list's sort order.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

items.description: A role granted to a user at a scope.

external_id.description: The owning system's id for the assignment; `null` for a `local` one.

items.description: The items, in the list's sort order.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

items.description: A user of the caller's organization.

external_id.description: The owning system's id for the user; `null` when there is none.

items.description: The items, in the list's sort order.

next_cursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page; `null` on the last page.

grantable.description: The scope types at which a role assignment grants it.

PlanRef.description: Which plan the organization runs on and how it got it.

key.description: The plan's key; `unlimited` for a self-hosted organization.

PlanSource.description:
How the organization got its plan: a subscription (`stripe`), granted by the operator
(`grant`), the non-profit plan (`nonprofit`), or the self-hosted `unlimited` plan
(`selfhost`).

Problem.description: The body of every error response (RFC 9457).

detail.description: A sentence for a human reader. Clients branch on `code`, never on this text.

errors.description: On a 422, each rule the body broke.

limit.description:
On `entitlement.limit_reached`, the key of the limit the request would pass, such as
`users`.

max.description: On `entitlement.limit_reached`, the plan's value for that limit.

type.description: `about:blank` until the docs site documents each code.

ReadingFont.description: The reading font: the bundled serif, or the organization's UI font.

Role.description: A built-in role or a custom role of the organization.

builtin.description: Built-in roles are the same in every organization and cannot be changed or deleted.

permissions.description: The permission keys the role grants. A built-in role's are this server's list for it.

RoleAssignment.description: A role granted to a user at a scope.

external_id.description: The owning system's id for the assignment; `null` for a `local` one.

RolePatch.description: A change to a custom role; an omitted member is left as it is.

permissions.description:
The role's whole new list, each catalog key at most once. The caller must hold at
organization scope every key it adds and every key it drops.

SavedInputs.description: The saved inputs, every choice made.

ScopeRef.description: The scope a new assignment takes effect at.

ScopeType.description: The kind of scope a permission can take effect at.

UiFont.description: A UI font the instance bundles.

User.description: A user of the caller's organization.

external_id.description: The owning system's id for the user; `null` when there is none.

UserPatch.description:
A change to a user; an omitted member is left as it is. A member sent as `null` is
malformed, except `email`, where `null` removes the email.

display_name.description: Trimmed; 1 to 200 characters. Refused for a user an outside source owns.

email.description:
Trimmed; at most 254 characters; `null` removes it. Refused for a user an outside source
owns.

family_name.description: At most 200 characters. Refused for a user an outside source owns.

given_name.description: At most 200 characters. Refused for a user an outside source owns.

status.description:
`suspended` ends every session of the user on its next request; you cannot suspend
yourself.

UserSource.description:
Where the user record came from: made by an admin (`local`), at sign-in through an identity
provider (`idp`), or by the sync API, SCIM or a connector, which own it.

UserStatus.description: Whether a user may sign in.

AccountNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: no account with this id exists in the organization, or you cannot see it. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

AssignmentCreateConflict.description: `role_assignment.exists`: the user already holds the role at the scope. `role.unknown_builtin`: the role is a built-in role of another Stepclimb release.

AssignmentCreateForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `role.assign` at the scope. `permission.escalation`: the role has a catalog permission the caller does not hold at the scope, counting permissions that take no effect there. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

AssignmentCreateNotFound.description: `user.not_found`: no user of the organization has this id. `role.not_found`: no built-in role and no custom role of the organization has this id. `account.not_found`: the scope names no account of the organization, or one you cannot see. `org.not_found`: the scope names another organization, or the request's organization cannot be determined.

AssignmentDeleteConflict.description: `role.unknown_builtin`: the assignment's role is a built-in role of another Stepclimb release. `role_assignment.externally_managed`: an identity provider, the sync API, SCIM or a connector owns the assignment. `role_assignment.last_org_admin`: it is the organization's last organization-scope Organization admin assignment held by an active user.

AssignmentDeleteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `role.assign` at the assignment's scope. `permission.escalation`: the role has a catalog permission the caller does not hold at the scope, counting permissions that take no effect there. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

AssignmentDeleteNotFound.description: `role_assignment.not_found`: no assignment of the organization has this id, or its scope is hidden from you. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

AssignmentListNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: the scope filter names no account of the organization, or one you cannot see. `org.not_found`: the scope filter names another organization, or the request's organization cannot be determined.

BadRequest.description: `request.malformed`: the body, a path parameter or a query parameter does not parse or does not match the schema, or `limit` is outside 1 to 200. `pagination.invalid_cursor`: the cursor does not decode.

BrandingInvalid.description: `branding.invalid_input`: an input fails validation; `errors` names it (`branding.invalid_color`, `branding.too_long`, `branding.not_a_choice`). `branding.contrast_failed`: a generated theme has a failing contrast pair; `report` lists every appearance's pairs, failing pairs first.

BrandingWriteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `branding.manage` at organization scope. `entitlement.feature_unavailable`: the organization's plan does not include `custom_branding`. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

CreateConflict.description: `role.key_taken`: a built-in role or another custom role of the organization has the key.

CreateForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: you hold `account.manage` nowhere, or you can see the parent without holding it there. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

CsrfRefused.description: `auth.csrf_refused`: an unsafe request without a bearer credential did not come from this site: `Sec-Fetch-Site` is not `same-origin`, `Origin` is sent but is not an allowed origin, or neither header is sent.

DeleteConflict.description: `role.builtin_immutable`: built-in roles cannot be deleted. `role.in_use`: the role still has assignments; remove them first.

DeleteForbidden.description: `entitlement.feature_unavailable`: the organization's plan does not include custom roles. `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `role.manage` at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

DeleteNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: the account does not exist or you cannot see its parent. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

IdentityDeleteConflict.description: `identity.last_sign_in_method`: the user would be left with no way to sign in.

IdentityDeleteNotFound.description: `user.not_found`: no user of the organization has this id. `identity.not_found`: the user has no identity with this id. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

IdentityLinkConflict.description: `identity.taken`: this provider's subject is already linked to a user.

IdentityWriteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `user.manage` at organization scope. `permission.escalation`: the user holds a permission, at any scope, that the caller does not hold at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

InternalError.description: `internal.error`: the server failed; the cause is in its log.

ManageForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: you can see the account but do not hold `account.manage` at a scope containing it (for a delete, the account's parent). `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

MethodNotAllowed.description: `request.method_not_allowed`: the path does not take this method; `Allow` lists the methods it takes.

MoveConflict.description: `account.root_immutable`: the root account cannot be moved. `account.move_into_descendant`: the destination is the account itself or one of its descendants. `account.too_deep`: an account of the moved subtree would end more than 16 levels below the root.

MoveForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: you can see the account's parent but do not hold `account.manage` there. `permission.escalation`: the destination would give you, over the moved account, a permission you do not hold over it now. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

MoveNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: the account does not exist or you cannot see its parent, or the destination `parent_id` does not exist or is outside every subtree where you hold `account.manage`. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

MyIdentityDeleteConflict.description: `identity.last_sign_in_method`: you would be left with no way to sign in. `identity.externally_managed`: an identity provider, the sync API, SCIM or a connector owns your user record and would link the identity again; ask an admin.

MyIdentityNotFound.description: `identity.not_found`: you have no identity with this id. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

NoOrganization.description: `org.none`: the instance has no organization yet.

OrgWriteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `organization.manage` at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

OrganizationNotFound.description: `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

ParentNotFound.description: `account.not_found`: no account with `parent_id` exists in the organization, or you cannot see it. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

PayloadTooLarge.description: `request.too_large`: the body is larger than the server accepts.

PermissionDenied.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold the operation's permission at a scope containing its target.

RateLimited.description: `auth.rate_limited`: too many sign-in or token requests from this client address, or too many failed password or TOTP checks for this account; `Retry-After` gives the seconds until the limit's window closes.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again, at least 1.

RoleNotFound.description: `role.not_found`: no built-in role and no custom role of the organization has this id. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

RouteNotFound.description: `request.not_found`: no API operation has this path.

SettingsInvalid.description: `request.invalid`: the patch breaks a rule; `errors` lists each one. `settings.unknown_key` marks a key that is no organization setting; `tz.unknown` a `default_tz` that is no IANA time zone; `settings.email_matching_unavailable` an `email_matching` of `true`, which this release refuses.

Unauthenticated.description: `auth.unauthenticated`: no credential, or one that names no session of the organization. `auth.session_expired`: the session passed its idle or absolute expiry. `auth.suspended`: the user is suspended.

UnprocessableEntity.description: `request.invalid`: the body parses but breaks a rule; `errors` lists each one.

UserCreateConflict.description: `user.external_id_taken`: another user of the organization has this external id. `user.email_taken`: another user of the organization has this email, in any letter case. `identity.taken`: one of `identities` is already linked to a user.

UserCreateForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `user.manage` at organization scope. `entitlement.limit_reached`: the organization's plan allows no more users; `limit` and `max` name the limit and its value. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

UserNotFound.description: `user.not_found`: no user of the organization has this id. `org.not_found`: the request's organization cannot be determined.

UserUpdateConflict.description: `user.externally_managed`: an identity provider, the sync API, SCIM or a connector owns the user's names and email; change them there. `user.cannot_suspend_self`: you cannot suspend yourself. `user.email_taken`: another user of the organization has this email, in any letter case. `role_assignment.last_org_admin`: the user is the organization's last active Organization admin.

UserWriteForbidden.description: `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `user.manage` at organization scope. `permission.escalation`: the patch changes `email` or `status` of a user who holds a permission the caller does not hold at organization scope. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.

WriteForbidden.description: `entitlement.feature_unavailable`: the organization's plan does not include custom roles. `permission.denied`: the caller does not hold `role.manage` at organization scope. `permission.escalation`: the caller does not hold, at organization scope, a permission the role gains or loses. `auth.csrf_refused`: the request did not come from this site.
